Опросник NPS.d: Asks about satisfaction and collects feedback
Опросник NPS.full: Asks about satisfaction at the right moments, rather than everyone once a year. It collects scores with comments, calculates the index and separates a one off irritation from a systemic problem.
Опросник NPS.lim: Never spams the same client with surveys
Опросник NPS.pain: You do not know what people think of you until you read a review on a public site

Аккаунт-менеджер.d: Looks after the client after the sale and finds room to grow
Аккаунт-менеджер.full: Looks after the client after the sale: regular contact, working through their tasks, finding reasons to expand. It remembers the whole relationship and notices when a client goes quiet, before they leave.
Аккаунт-менеджер.lim: Does not solve technical issues, it brings in the right people
Аккаунт-менеджер.pain: The client went quiet six months ago and you noticed at renewal

Мультиязычный агент.d: Correspondence and documents in English and Arabic
Мультиязычный агент.full: Handles correspondence and prepares documents in English and Arabic keeping the meaning and the business tone, not machine translation. You need it where the client or partner does not speak your language and losing the deal over it is not an option.
Мультиязычный агент.lim: Legally binding documents are checked by a person
Мультиязычный агент.pain: A deal with a foreign client stalls on language and goes elsewhere

Здоровье клиента.d: Watches usage and catches churn risk
Здоровье клиента.full: Watches how the client uses the product: how often, how deep, who on their team logged in, where they stopped. It scores churn risk and raises the flag early, while there is still time to step in.
Здоровье клиента.lim: Does not contact the client itself, it signals the account manager
Здоровье клиента.pain: The client quietly stops using the product and leaves without warning

Биллинг.d: Issues invoices and watches the payments in
Биллинг.res: Nothing is left unbilled or uncollected
Биллинг.full: Issues invoices for contracts and subscriptions, watches the money coming in and closes the paperwork. It does not let an invoice be forgotten, and does not let a payment get lost in the bank statement.
Биллинг.lim: Never takes money from clients on its own
Биллинг.pain: The invoice was never issued and the payment was never checked

Дебиторка.d: Chases debtors and keeps the repayment schedule
Дебиторка.full: Keeps everyone who owes you in view: due dates, amounts, days overdue. It reminds clients with escalating firmness, escalates to the manager and shows how much is outstanding right now and when it will realistically land.
Дебиторка.lim: Does not threaten and never goes to court without a person's decision
Дебиторка.pain: Money sits with clients and there is nobody to chase it, and it feels awkward

Зарплаты и бонусы.full: Calculates pay, bonuses and commission by the incentive rules: targets, actuals, coefficients. It makes the maths visible, so nobody feels their bonus was estimated by eye.
Зарплаты и бонусы.lim: Does not make the payments, it prepares the calculation
Зарплаты и бонусы.pain: Bonuses are calculated by hand, people argue and do not trust the numbers

Управленческий учёт.d: Builds the P&L and unit economics
Управленческий учёт.res: You know what actually makes money
Управленческий учёт.full: Builds the P&L and unit economics: what you really earn by line of business, product and client after all costs. It answers the question of what feeds the company and what lives off it.
Управленческий учёт.pain: Profit is estimated by eye and it is unclear what really feeds the company

Инвест-аналитик.d: Works out payback on projects and investments
Инвест-аналитик.res: Decisions on numbers, not on feel
Инвест-аналитик.full: Works out payback on projects and investments: time to return, sensitivity to scenarios, what happens if it goes worse than planned. It prepares the calculation for a decision, not a pretty deck.
Инвест-аналитик.lim: Does not give investment advice, it models the options
Инвест-аналитик.pain: Investment decisions are made on gut feel rather than on maths

Претензии и споры.full: Prepares claims and supporting documents, counts the deadlines and gathers the evidence into one folder in chronological order. It runs the dispute stage by stage so nothing is missed procedurally.
Претензии и споры.lim: Does not represent you in court
Претензии и споры.pain: Debts and breaches go unanswered because preparing a claim takes too long

Финансист.full: Keeps the company's money in view: money in, money out, balances across every account and entity. Every morning it sends the summary, sees a cash gap coming and explains what is causing it.
Финансист.lim: Read only access to the bank, it never sends payments
Финансист.pain: Balances are collected by hand and a cash gap only becomes visible after the fact

Скоринг платёжеспособности.d: Assesses whether the client can actually pay
Скоринг платёжеспособности.res: Fewer shipments to people who will not pay
Скоринг платёжеспособности.full: Assesses the client's financial condition before you ship: turnover, debt load, payment history with you and with the market. It suggests the terms: prepayment, instalments or shipment against a guarantee.
Скоринг платёжеспособности.lim: A probability, not a guarantee of payment
Скоринг платёжеспособности.pain: You shipped to someone who could not pay and now it is your problem

Трудовые документы.full: Prepares HR documents: contracts, orders, agreements, notices. It checks that the paperwork matches the actual situation, so you do not have to sort it out in a labour dispute later.
Трудовые документы.pain: HR paperwork is done however it comes out, and the risk surfaces at the first dispute

Бюджет и план-факт.d: Compares plan with actual by line
Бюджет и план-факт.full: Compares plan with actual by line and by department, finds the overspend and explains the cause in numbers. It shows where you are going over while there is still time to correct it.
Бюджет и план-факт.lim: Does not cut costs itself, it prepares the basis for a decision
Бюджет и план-факт.pain: Overspend is found when the money is already gone

Юрист.res: Documents in minutes instead of days
Юрист.full: Prepares contracts, invoices, acts and annexes from your templates in minutes. It checks the terms against the standard ones, highlights the risky clauses and explains in plain words what they mean. It keeps a register of documents so the right one takes seconds to find.
Юрист.lim: The signature and the final decision always stay with a person
Юрист.pain: A contract waits days for the lawyer while the deal stands still

Контроль расходов.full: Watches subscriptions, recurring charges and the small spending nobody checks. It finds forgotten services, double payments and suppliers who quietly raised their prices.
Контроль расходов.lim: Never cancels a subscription without confirmation
Контроль расходов.pain: Subscriptions and small charges drip for years and nobody adds them up

Внутренние коммуникации.d: Gets news and changes across to the team
Внутренние коммуникации.res: Everyone knows what is going on
Внутренние коммуникации.full: Gets news and changes across to the team: what changed, who it affects, what to do. It checks the message actually landed instead of dissolving in a group chat.
Внутренние коммуникации.lim: Does not send out anything that is not approved
Внутренние коммуникации.pain: Important things sink in the group chat and half the team never sees them

Онбординг сотрудника.d: Walks a new hire in by checklist
Онбординг сотрудника.full: Walks a new hire through the first weeks by checklist: access, introductions, materials, first tasks, checkpoints. It watches that the person is not stuck and nudges their mentor.
Онбординг сотрудника.lim: Does not assess the probation period
Онбординг сотрудника.pain: A new hire spends a month working out who to ask about what

Мотивация и KPI.d: Tracks target completion and shows progress
Мотивация и KPI.full: Tracks each person against their targets: actuals, percentage, forecast to the end of the period, bonus size by the rules. It shows people their progress during the month rather than after the fact.
Мотивация и KPI.lim: Does not change the incentive rules on its own
Мотивация и KPI.pain: People see their result at the end of the month, when it is too late to change it

Бриф по сотрудникам.d: Keeps a profile of each person: strengths and growth areas
Бриф по сотрудникам.res: Work goes to the right strengths
Бриф по сотрудникам.full: Keeps a profile of every person: strengths, growth areas, what they do best, which tasks drain them. It suggests who should take which task so the work lands on the right strengths.
Бриф по сотрудникам.lim: Does not store sensitive personal data
Бриф по сотрудникам.pain: Work is handed out blind, without regard for who is good at what

Собеседующий.d: Runs the first interview and writes the conclusions
Собеседующий.full: Runs the first interview to a structure: experience, motivation, expectations, dealbreakers. It writes the conclusions in one format so candidates can be compared side by side rather than by impression.
Собеседующий.lim: The hiring decision stays with the manager
Собеседующий.pain: The manager burns evenings on interviews with people who do not fit

Диспетчер.d: Creates and moves cards and tasks across systems
Диспетчер.full: Creates and moves tasks in your working systems: writes them up, assigns an owner, sets the deadline, reminds and escalates when it slips. It makes sure nothing falls between people and systems.
Диспетчер.lim: Does not close other people's tasks without confirmation
Диспетчер.pain: Tasks get lost between people and systems

Проджект-менеджер.full: Runs the whole project: plan, stages, deadlines, budget, owners, risks. It assembles the status for the client, catches slippage and proposes what to move to still make the date.
Проджект-менеджер.lim: Does not change the terms of the client contract
Проджект-менеджер.pain: The project slips and everyone realises it at the end

Сервис и ремонт.full: Runs maintenance and warranty requests: intake, status, deadlines, history per unit. It reminds about scheduled maintenance so equipment does not stop without warning.
Сервис и ремонт.lim: Does not perform the repair, it keeps the records and the communication
Сервис и ремонт.pain: The client forgets about maintenance and the equipment stops at the worst possible moment

Складской учёт.res: No shortages and no dead stock
Складской учёт.full: Watches stock levels and movement: what is running out, what is sitting still, how much money is frozen in the warehouse. It warns you to reorder in advance.
Складской учёт.lim: Does not do the physical stocktake
Складской учёт.pain: Stock runs out without warning or sits there freezing your money

Сбор обратной связи.d: Gathers client requests in one place
Сбор обратной связи.full: Gathers requests and complaints from every channel into one place: support, sales, reviews, interviews. It groups the similar ones so you can see what is asked for most often rather than who shouts loudest.
Сбор обратной связи.lim: Does not decide what goes into development
Сбор обратной связи.pain: Client requests are scattered across chats and lead nowhere
